name: get_portfolios
description: Get all portfolios for the current user

name: get_portfolio_assets_with_discovery
description: PRIMARY FUNCTION FOR PORTFOLIO ANALYSIS - Get comprehensive portfolio holdings with current prices, values, and performance metrics. Automatically discovers the default portfolio if no portfolio_id is specified.

portfolio_id.description: Optional specific portfolio ID. If not provided, uses default portfolio.

name: get_portfolio_diversification
description: Get portfolio diversification breakdown by asset type, sector, and currency

name: get_all_transactions
description: Get all transactions for the user with pagination support

sort.description: Sort field: date, amount, type (default: date)

order.description: Sort order: asc or desc (default: desc)

name: get_user_watchlist
description: Get the user's watchlist of tracked assets (NOT owned, just tracked for monitoring)

name: get_watchlist_with_market_data
description: Get watchlist with current market prices, 24h changes, and performance metrics including price alert status

name: add_to_watchlist
description: Add an asset to the user's watchlist for tracking

type.description: Asset type: stock, crypto, etf, bond, commodity

exchange.description: Exchange where the asset is traded

name: remove_from_watchlist
description: Remove an asset from the user's watchlist

name: search_assets

name: get_trending_assets
description: Get trending/popular assets based on market activity

name: get_top_gainers

name: get_top_losers
description: Get top losing assets by percentage change

name: get_analyst_ratings
description: Get analyst ratings and recommendations for a stock from major financial institutions

name: get_financial_ratios
description: Get financial ratios for a company including P/E, P/B, ROE, ROA, debt ratios, and more

name: get_price_targets
description: Get analyst price targets for a stock including consensus, high, low, and individual analyst targets

name: get_company_profile

name: get_asset_sentiment
description: Get market sentiment for an asset based on news and social media analysis

name: llm_get_crypto_news
description: Fetch cryptocurrency news from multiple RSS sources with optional topic filtering. Returns articles from 14+ crypto news sites including CoinDesk, CoinTelegraph, Decrypt, TheBlock, Bitcoin Magazine, and more. Server-side topic filtering reduces token usage by 80-90%.

source.description: Optional: specific source name (coindesk, cointelegraph, decrypt, theblock, bitcoinmagazine, cryptonews, newsbtc, cryptopotato, readwrite, coingape, bankless, beincrypto, blockworks, cryptopolitan). If omitted, returns news from all sources.

topic.description: Optional: Filter articles by topic/keyword (case-insensitive). Searches in titles and descriptions. Supports multiple keywords separated by commas (e.g., "bitcoin,BTC" or "ethereum,ETH"). Server-side filtering dramatically reduces token usage.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles per source (default: 20)

name: llm_list_crypto_sources
description: List all available cryptocurrency news sources with their configuration, priority, and status. Useful for discovering which sources are available.

name: llm_get_news_by_source
description: Get news from a specific cryptocurrency news source by its identifier, with optional topic filtering.

name: llm_get_priority_crypto_news
description: Get news from only the highest-priority cryptocurrency news sources (CoinDesk, CoinTelegraph, Decrypt, TheBlock) with optional topic filtering. Use this for the most reliable and breaking news.

name: serpapi_search
description: Search the web using Google via SerpAPI. Use for current events, company info, product research, software tools, and any information not available through other functions.

name: brave_search
description: Search the web using Brave Search API. Fallback search option when SerpAPI is unavailable.
